note: 20 invented clean GP notes (no medicine named) written before the vocabulary was tuned; V18 must pass all of them.

notes.symptoms: Sore throat for 3 days with mild fever. No cough. No difficulty swallowing.
notes.examination: Throat congested. Tonsils not enlarged. Temperature 99.6 F.
notes.advice: Warm salt water gargles. Drink warm fluids.
notes.follow_up: Return if fever persists beyond 3 days.

notes.symptoms: Lower back pain for 1 week after lifting a heavy box. No leg numbness.
notes.examination: Paraspinal muscle tenderness. Straight leg raise negative.
notes.advice: Avoid lifting heavy weights. Apply a warm compress.
notes.follow_up: Review in two weeks.

notes.symptoms: Headache on and off for 2 weeks, worse in the evening. No vomiting. No blurred vision.
notes.examination: Neurological examination normal. Blood pressure 124/80.
notes.advice: Sleep at a fixed time. Limit screen time at night.
notes.follow_up: Come back if the headache wakes you from sleep.

notes.symptoms: Loose stools 4 times a day since yesterday. Mild abdominal cramps. No blood in stool.
notes.examination: Abdomen soft, mild periumbilical tenderness. Mild dehydration.
notes.plan: Oral fluids and a light diet.
notes.advice: Drink plenty of clean water. Eat light home food.
notes.follow_up: Return at once if there is blood in the stool or you cannot keep fluids down.

notes.symptoms: Itchy rash on both forearms for 5 days after gardening.
notes.examination: Erythematous papules on both forearms. No pus.
notes.advice: Wear gloves while gardening. Do not scratch.
notes.follow_up: Review in one week if not better.

notes.symptoms: Burning in the upper abdomen after meals for 1 month. Worse on lying down.
notes.examination: Mild epigastric tenderness. No guarding.
notes.advice: Eat small meals. Do not lie down soon after eating. Raise the head end of the bed.
notes.follow_up: Review in four weeks.

notes.symptoms: Pain and swelling in the right ankle after a twist while walking yesterday.
notes.examination: Swelling over the lateral malleolus. Able to bear weight.
notes.advice: Keep the foot raised. Apply ice for fifteen minutes three times a day.
notes.follow_up: Return if you cannot walk on it.

notes.symptoms: Runny nose and sneezing every morning for 2 months. Itchy eyes.
notes.examination: Pale, swollen nasal mucosa. Clear discharge.
notes.advice: Keep the bedroom free of dust. Wash bed sheets weekly.
notes.follow_up: Review in one month.

notes.symptoms: Fatigue and weight gain for 3 months. Feels cold often.
notes.examination: Dry skin. Pulse 62 per minute.
notes.advice: Bring the report at the next visit.
notes.follow_up: Follow up with reports.

notes.symptoms: Frequent urination and increased thirst for 1 month.
notes.examination: BMI 29. Random blood sugar 248 mg/dL.
notes.plan: Fasting and post-meal sugar and HbA1c ordered.
notes.advice: Cut down on sweets and sugary drinks. Walk thirty minutes daily.
notes.follow_up: Review with reports in one week.

notes.symptoms: Ear pain on the left side for 2 days with reduced hearing.
notes.examination: Left tympanic membrane red and bulging.
notes.advice: Do not put anything inside the ear. Keep water out of the ear while bathing.
notes.follow_up: Return if discharge appears from the ear.

notes.symptoms: Chest tightness on climbing stairs for 2 weeks, relieved by rest.
notes.examination: Heart sounds normal. Blood pressure 148/92.
notes.plan: ECG and lipid profile ordered. Cardiology referral discussed.
notes.advice: Stop smoking. Avoid heavy exertion until reviewed.
notes.follow_up: Go to the emergency department at once if the chest pain lasts more than ten minutes.

notes.symptoms: Painful red eye on the right side since this morning with watering.
notes.examination: Right conjunctival congestion. Vision normal.
notes.advice: Wash hands often. Do not share towels.
notes.follow_up: Return if vision becomes blurred.

notes.symptoms: Knee pain on both sides for 6 months, worse on climbing stairs. Morning stiffness for 10 minutes.
notes.examination: Crepitus in both knees. No effusion.
notes.advice: Do the knee exercises daily. Avoid squatting.
notes.follow_up: Review in six weeks.

notes.symptoms: Cough with yellow sputum for 1 week and fever for 3 days. Breathlessness on exertion.
notes.examination: Crackles at the right lung base. SpO2 95 percent.
notes.plan: Chest X-ray and complete blood count ordered.
notes.advice: Rest and drink fluids.
notes.follow_up: Come to the emergency department at once if breathing gets worse.

notes.symptoms: Missed period for 6 weeks. Mild nausea in the mornings.
notes.examination: Abdomen soft. Blood pressure 110/70.
notes.plan: Urine pregnancy test and ultrasound ordered.
notes.advice: Eat small frequent meals. Avoid alcohol and smoking.
notes.follow_up: Return at once if there is bleeding or severe pain.

notes.symptoms: Anxiety and poor sleep for 2 months after a job change.
notes.examination: Alert and oriented. Pulse 88 per minute.
notes.advice: Keep a regular sleep routine. Take a daily walk.
notes.follow_up: Review in two weeks.

notes.symptoms: Child with fever for 1 day and two episodes of vomiting. Playful between fevers.
notes.examination: Temperature 101 F. Throat mildly red. Well hydrated.
notes.advice: Give plenty of fluids. Sponge with lukewarm water.
notes.follow_up: Return at once if the child is drowsy or not drinking.

notes.symptoms: Dizziness on standing up for 1 week. No fainting.
notes.examination: Lying blood pressure 122/78, standing 104/70.
notes.advice: Stand up slowly. Drink more water during the day.
notes.follow_up: Review in one week.

notes.symptoms: Painful urination and lower abdominal pain for 2 days. No fever.
notes.examination: Suprapubic tenderness. No renal angle tenderness.
notes.advice: Drink at least three litres of water a day.
notes.follow_up: Return if fever or back pain develops.
